Thanks for the pull request. We accept contributions that are good and useful.

Please say what this changes and why. Keep it to one logical change, and make sure the
build and the tests pass. The details are in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mas-bandwidth/fixed3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

If this is your first contribution to a Más Bandwidth repository, a bot will ask you to
sign the [Contributor Assignment Agreement](https://github.com/mas-bandwidth/.github/blob/main/CAA.md)
on this pull request. One signature covers everything you contribute after it.
